options.name: area
options.description: This option allows the configuration of OSPF areas on an AlliedWare Plus device.

options.name: network_area
options.description: Used to enable OSPF routing with a specified Area ID on any interfaces which match the specified network address.

options.name: ospf_router_id
options.description: This option is used to specific a router ID for the OSPF process.

options.name: passive_interface
options.description: This option is used to suppress the sending of Hello packets on all interfaces, or on a specified interface. If no interface name is specified, then all interfaces are put into passive mode.

options.name: redistribute
options.description: This option is used to redistribute routes from other routing protocols, static routes, and connected routes into an OSPF routing table.

options.name: router
options.description: This configures the router to use OSPF.

options.name: summary_address
options.description: This option is used to summarize, or possibly suppres, external routes that have the specified address range.
